lead: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share after the close (above its $70-78 range; Nasdaq debut Thursday Nov 19 as ANT), putting Amazon's ~$18B investment at about $289B and Alphabet's at about $147B; Amazon stock was up 2.8% at midday on the stake (closing move not confirmed).
why: Anthropic IPO: priced at $83 (Reuters/Bloomberg via sources), above the $70-78 range, books reportedly ~6-7x oversubscribed; at least $68B raised, ~$1.5T valuation (Forbes); trades Thursday as ANT.

Amazon's stake: ~15% (Forbes), ~$18B invested; worth ~$271.8B at $78 incl. 1.56B shares to be issued later under a 12% cap (Reuters calc via 24/7 Wall St.), ~$289B at $83; Alphabet ~$147B at $83. Anthropic has also pledged $110B+ of AWS purchases through April 2036 (Benzinga).

Caution: every one of the 12 biggest US IPOs since 2008 fell below its first trade within a year; SpaceX, SK hynix and Cerebras trade below their first trades (Yahoo Finance). Market: Dow -1.11%, S&P -0.23%, Nasdaq +0.42%; Nvidia -2.9% to ~$150.96; Palo Alto +9.9% on results and a $4.5B Applied Compute deal.
